text:
Connor O'Brien: Heads up: planning beta rollout sequencing for Shadow Traffic / Shadow Evals. Want to lock region order + confirm rollback runbook readiness before we flip any customer flags.

Talia Benson: :eyes: following. Are we still targeting week of Nov 18 for first external beta?

Connor O'Brien: Yep. Proposal is staged by region + hard caps.
1) internal only (dogfood) us-east-1
2) beta cohort in us-east-1
3) eu-west-1
4) ap-southeast-1 last

Connor O'Brien: Rationale: most of the telemetry + queue tuning we’ve been doing is in us-east, and SRE wants first paging playbook validated before EU/APAC.

Sean Gallagher: +1. Also capacity headroom is best in us-east right now. EU is okay but we want the first week to be “boring”.

Dylan Brooks: For Console, feature flag is per-org + per-route. Can do regional enablement by only allowing shadow targets in the region + rejecting cross-region shadowing.

Allison Grant: Please make sure we’re not mixing metrics namespaces during rollout. Grafana panels assume `shadow_eval.*` only and will look broken if half the traffic emits old tags.

Jada Williams: Policy engine side: default shadow sampling is 0%. Needs explicit per-route config + allowlist. We can ship code to all regions but keep flags off.

Connor O'Brien: Great. On rollback: I want to confirm we have *two* levels:
- global kill switch (no shadow execution anywhere)
- per-route disable (shadow_sampling=0 OR remove shadow targets)

Rafael Mendes: Runbook is ready on the oncall side. The “kill switch” path is tested in staging + prod. Steps are basically:
1) toggle global kill switch in admin console
2) verify queue depth drops + shadow runner workers stop pulling
3) confirm primary latency unchanged

Rafael Mendes: We should link the runbook directly in the beta checklist + pin it in #eng-sre during beta week.

Sean Gallagher: Any dependencies before we say “runbook ready”? The thing that bit us last time was not having an obvious verification query.

Rafael Mendes: Added explicit verification:
- dashboard panel: shadow runner queue depth / dropped count
- query: shadow_eval.run.count by region should go to ~0 within 2–3 mins
- and primary request p99 panel should not move (we watch the perf canary too)

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: redwood-api @ 2025-11-19 18:00 UTC (shadow runner + policy schema)

Marissa Cole: From product side: beta comms assume we can enable per customer, and that “shadow never affects responses.” Please confirm that rollback does not require deploy.

Jada Williams: No deploy required. Global kill switch + per-route disable are config-driven. Worst case we can also set sampling to 0 via policy patch.

Dylan Brooks: Console exposes admin toggle + shows “shadow execution disabled globally” banner so support doesn’t get confused.

Sean Gallagher: Rollout order looks fine, but I’d prefer we hold EU until:
- 48h of stable us-east with sampling <= 0.5%
- no sustained queue depth growth
- no shadow runner error rate spikes

Connor O'Brien: Works for me. Let’s capture as gating:
- us-east: start at 0.1% sampled, max 0.5% without explicit SRE approval
- after 48h stable -> enable eu-west at 0.1%
- ap-southeast only after 1 week stable across both

Allison Grant: Please also confirm tag cardinality guardrails are live *before* EU. EU customers tend to have higher route variability and we don’t want to explode metrics.

Dylan Brooks: ENG-2435 is merged, and backend drops/aggregates disallowed tags. Console filters will only show allowed dims.

Talia Benson: Who is the DRI during first external flips? Need a name for the beta schedule doc.

Connor O'Brien: I’ll own release coordination + flips. SRE coverage: @Sean Gallagher primary, @Rafael Mendes secondary for the first week.

Sean Gallagher: ok. We should also set an explicit “paging threshold” for queue depth. If queue depth > X for > Y mins, we kill-switch.

Rafael Mendes: Currently set to page at queue depth > 50k for 10 min in a region OR shadow drop rate > 2% sustained. (We can tweak after first day.)

Marissa Cole: Can we add a note that customer-facing dashboards might lag early on? Don’t want people opening Console and seeing ‘no data’ and thinking it’s broken.

Dylan Brooks: Yep. We have ~5–10 min aggregation delay. I’ll add copy to the beta flag tooltip.

Connor O'Brien: Action items:
- Connor: update beta release checklist w/ region sequencing + gating + runbook link
- Rafael: pin runbook + verification steps in #eng-sre day-of
- Dylan: ensure admin banner + console flag text reflect global disable state + data delay
- Sean: confirm alert thresholds final before Nov 18

Sean Gallagher: :thumbsup:

Rafael Mendes: :thumbsup: runbook is good to go.

DeployBot: Deploy completed: redwood-api @ 2025-11-19 18:42 UTC
